messages:
eli: Quick PSA — tiny reminder before the cutoff: please keep changelog entries short and CLI-friendly. Cutoff is Mar 19 23:59:00 UTC. Use the one-liner template, add the label `changelog/one-liner`, and if more context is needed link the PR rather than dumping long prose. Thx :sparkles:
priya: Ack. Can you paste a couple of real-world examples? I always worry mine are either too sparse or novella-length.
eli: Sure, here are 3 safe patterns (aim for <= 80 chars):
```
runtime: reduce KV-cache memory use for quantized T4s (opt-in)
api: add `model` query param to embeddings endpoint (backcompat)
docs: clarify rate-limit examples in quickstart
```
eli: Prefer this shape: `component: short action + optional parenthetical` + PR link. No bullet lists in the one-liner.
mateo: Quick checklist that helped me: 1) include component tag 2) include PR# or link 3) use imperative verb 4) keep <80 chars 5) add `changelog/one-liner` label.
sarah: For backports/branches — which branch should new fixes target? We have a merge conflict on the backport today.
release-bot: Current policy: default target = `main` for new features; `release/stable` for hotfixes/backports. Freeze window starts at cutoff. If you need a manual backport, ping @release-eng.
mateo: For the conflict: rebase your branch onto `release/stable` and push with `git push --force-with-lease`. If unsure, tag me and I can help.
priya: Thanks — I'll shrink mine now. One Q: is it okay to include a short parenthetical like `(opt-in)` vs `- opt-in`?
eli: Parenthetical is better — stays single-line. Avoid lists.
devex-bot: FYI: changelog linter will auto-suggest formatting fixes when you add the `changelog/one-liner` label. See <https://docs.redwood.inference/internal/changelog-template|changelog template>.
sarah: Small PSA for authors: if your one-liner touches customer-visible behavior, add a one-sentence blurb in the PR description and link it from the one-liner. That keeps the changelog compact while preserving context.
priya: Updated my PR with a tightened one-liner + PR link. Label added. :thumbsup:
eli: Nice — thank you. If anyone wants a super-short review ping me or @mateo before the freeze.
release-bot: Reminder: automated release notes job will run at cutoff and will only include entries with `changelog/one-liner` or `changelog/include` labels.
mateo: Also: if you reuse acronyms, please expand in the PR description once. Keeps release notes accessible to non-dev readers.
eli: OK closing thread — small reminders only. Appreciate the quick cleanups! :heart:
